items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: I didn't know buddy, you know, until my buddy come in there and got married when I worked for that beer for him, you know.

ctx.x: Ask him if he followed parades. You hear myself?

Yeah. So, did you ever follow parades much? Oh, that's all I used to do. When he used to drive down there in the Avatar Parade, Chuck, you know, furniture wagon. And then when a big parade comes, say, you know, the funeral or the parades, you know, like the archipelago and the mazler, you used to follow that all the time. I couldn't play music then, you know. He used to spot them all the time. And then, and that buddy Bowden, the lady just said,
I said, I don't have buddy Bowden, say,
